correctness.rationale: The source MSC gives \(e_1\) as unit, \(e_2^2=e_1\), \(e_2e_3=e_3e_2=e_3\), and \(e_3^2=t(e_1+e_2)+e_3\). Orthogonal idempotents \(p=(e_1+e_2)/2\) and \(q=(e_1-e_2)/2\) split off \(kq\), and \(w=2e_3-p\) satisfies \(w^2=(1+8t)p\). Explicit bases identify \(t=0\) with \(U_2^3\) and \(t=-1/8\) with \(U_3^3\). The finite-field automorphism orders follow from the direct-product factors and are exhaustively checked over \(\mathbb F_5\).
